# Home
Dear Clayton Community,
Throughout my career, I have dedicated myself to caring for individuals and have spent my years in Clayton serving this community. As a nurse and healthcare leader, I have held management, supervisory, pediatric special-needs, and care-management positions, earning recognition from Today’s Nurse for my advocacy and leadership in patient care. These experiences have taught me to listen attentively, ask tough questions, and make complex decisions when the stakes are high.
Currently, I serve on the Clayton Planning Commission, where I was Chair in 2025 and Vice Chair in 2024. In these roles, I helped guide thoughtful growth that preserves our small-town character. Additionally, I serve on the Clayton Community Library Foundation Board and volunteer at events such as Clayton Cleans Up, the Art & Wine Festival, the Fourth of July parade, and Oktoberfest.
I bring extensive experience in managing budgets, ensuring regulatory compliance, and being accountable for my decisions. I am not a political insider; I am committed to working on behalf of all Clayton residents.
My decision to run for office is inspired by the need to address significant challenges facing Clayton, including a limited budget, state housing mandates, aging infrastructure, fire safety, and the need to ensure residents have a seat at the table.
Please support my campaign by donating to support getting our message out and/or volunteer to help. You can also endorse my campaign too. I cannot do this without all of you!
Thank You!
## Vote Maria Shulman for Clayton City Council
### About Maria
My name is Maria Shulman, and my family and I have lived in Clayton for over 17 years. My daughter was educated at Mt. Diablo Elementary, Diablo View Middle School, and graduated from Clayton Valley Charter High School.
We knew from the moment we visited this community that we wanted to make it our home. We appreciate the small-town charm, Clayton’s beauty and quaintness, and the “essence” of what makes life in Clayton so special.
